cues.text: Jagged, deep blue icebergs jut from a sprawling, cracked frozen sea.
Snow drifts from a dark sky. A massive crescent moon dominates the horizon.
The colony ship streaks down from the upper atmosphere, burning white-hot.
It strikes the distant ice. A towering plume of white steam and shattered ice erupts high into the air, billowing outward into a massive cloud.

beats.note: A frozen, cracked sea with jagged blue icebergs jutting out.
Snow falls from a dark blue sky. A huge crescent moon hangs near the horizon.
The colony ship streaks down from the upper right sky.
The ship impacts the ice in the distance.
A massive plume of white steam and snow erupts from the impact site, billowing into a tall cloud.
